g.text: Which cell types changed? Calling cell-type pathway changes

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial'; fill: #555555

g.text: Negative control: unchanged cell type × pathway pairs flagged (fewer is better). Positive control: real changes in the drug's pathway (|true| ≥ 0.1) found with the right sign.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial'; fill: #555555

g.text: Effect accuracy: correlation of the estimated with the true change; responder AUROC ranks the 3 p53-intact lines (idasanutlin).

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial'; fill: #555555

g.text: Honest ranges: share of 90% ranges containing the true change (tools: t-test interval; the standard workflow gives none). Tools: BH q < 0.1; PALM: 90% range.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial'; fill: #555555

g.text: Bars scaled per column (longest = best); 1–3 = rank. Development splits 0–2. "PALM with X fractions": PALM's effect step on another tool's proportions.
